slides.title: Personal Brand Is a Reputation, Built Deliberately
bullets: Personal brand is the reputation built through every interaction, publication and public presence
In a trust-based field, cultivating it consciously is a real career investment
It must never slide into empty self-promotion or a commercial tone

slides.title: Substance Comes Before Visibility
bullets: The same rigor that grounds the whole function's credibility grounds personal brand
No communication strategy compensates for a lack of real scientific substance
Personal brand amplifies an already-earned reputation, it doesn't replace it

slides.title: Be Known for Something Specific
bullets: Deep recognized knowledge in a therapeutic area or a specific competency beats being a generalist
Examples include insight generation excellence or a particular methodological expertise
This makes others think of you naturally when a related need comes up

slides.title: Show Up Consistently and Add Real Value
bullets: Keep an updated, accurate LinkedIn profile without exaggerating your trajectory
Participate in professional forums and substantive scientific discussions
Contribute to internal training or best-practice initiatives
These build reputation organically, not through self-promotion

slides.title: Personal Brand Is Not Self-Promotion
bullets: Sharing achievements disproportionately backfires in a credibility-based field
Generic personal-marketing tone and technique undercut trust
The most effective personal brand is built indirectly, through sustained work quality

slides.title: Build It Before You Need It
bullets: Develop personal brand consciously from early in your career, not only when chasing a promotion
When a real opportunity arrives, an already-built reputation speaks for itself

takeaway.title: Personal brand in Medical Affairs is earned reputation, amplified, not manufactured
bullets: Scientific substance and consistent rigor are the non-negotiable foundation
Visible specialization and genuine contribution build reputation organically
Avoid a self-promotion tone; let sustained work quality speak for itself
